plans.note: Cap in 21.1 is one month of Fees and expressly 'without exception', which overrides the Excluded Claims regime in 21.2-21.3; primary edit is 21.1 (raise multiple and subject to carve-outs), with 21.3 checked for completeness of carve-outs.

Section 20 contains only a broad Customer-in-favour-of-Vendor indemnity (20.1); no Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity exists even though 9.3 cross-references a non-existent Section 20.5, so Vendor indemnity and IP remedies must be inserted and 20.1 narrowed.
12.4 imposes a 24-month worldwide non-compete on us and directly contradicts our protective 12.3; target deletion of 12.4.
The first 2.2 makes Vendor our sole and exclusive analytics provider (note duplicate 2.2 numbering with sec-2.2-2 order of precedence); inconsistent with 12.3 and with the volume commitment in 2.1.

No MFN obligation running against us appears; 12.3 expressly disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment. Verify pricing sections 7.1 and 8.3 contain no best-terms undertaking before closing as compliant.
No non-solicit or no-hire binding us; 12.3 preserves general recruitment hiring. Confirm no hiring restriction hides in the personnel provisions (30.1) before treating as absent.

9.4 gives us convenience termination on 30 days with refunds and denies Vendor a reciprocal right; the tension is 2.1's take-or-pay 'without reduction or termination rights', which should be conformed to 9.4.
8.2 gives a 30-day opt-out with a 60-day reminder and 8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI/3%; verify the reminder-failure extension and that no auto-renewal fee escalator sits in an Order Form.
New York law and New York County courts are on the approved list and there is no arbitration clause; likely compliant, confirm 28.3 escalation does not bar urgent relief.

24.1 permits our affiliate/successor assignment, 24.2 restricts Vendor, and 24.4 blocks Vendor rights on our change of control; check 24.3's residual consent requirement does not swallow 24.1 and that 13.3 licence transfer aligns.

14.1-14.2 give us Customer Data and Deliverable ownership with assignment; scrutinise the Deliverable/Vendor Technology definitions (1.4, 1.8) and 14.3/14.4 for scope leakage, plus 15.1 for model-training use of our data.
13.1 is the offending grant — Customer alone, no Affiliates or contractors, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion; fix against the standard set by 13.2 and the revocation limits in 13.3.
22.1-22.3 already provide once-yearly, 30-day notice, off-site, Vendor-cost audits with a 5% shortfall shift; likely compliant, confirm no separate records/assurance audit right in Section 23.
No liquidated damages or penalty payable by us appears; service credits are referenced only in 1.5 and 7.2. Watch 2.1's take-or-pay and 7.3 interest language as functional penalties.
19.2 cuts the Deliverable warranty to 15 days with no correction or refund thereafter, which also undercuts the 19.4 remedy; extend duration and delete the sunset of remedies.
18.1 lists CGL, WC, E&L, E&O and USD 5M cyber cover with 18.2 certificates and non-limitation language; present and broadly at position.
2.1 imposes a USD 2M/year three-year take-or-pay expressly without reduction or termination rights, contradicting 12.3 and 9.4; seek deletion or an exit/credit mechanism.

11.2-11.3 give data return and certified deletion, but 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion with no export or migration support; delete 11.1 and add a priced transition-assistance period consistent with 10.1.
